welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.text: Machining tools, tool management and industrial software, brought together in three companies. Tap one of them or Start to get to know the group.
welcome.hint: Drag to explore, pinch to zoom or scroll the mouse wheel to move on.

about.title: About us
about.lead: We make and recondition machining tools, manage those tools inside the customer's plant and build the software that keeps the process under control. Each company solves one part, and together they cover the whole path.
about.sectors: We serve the automotive, aerospace, oil & gas and other demanding sectors.
about.pick: Tap a company to learn more

m3code.name: M3 Code
m3code.intro: Builds custom systems for industry of any size. It removes manual, repetitive tasks to give management more control and accuracy.
m3code.highlight: Our mission: deliver innovative, functional solutions that improve our customers' productivity.
m3code.roleText: Builds custom systems for production management, invoices and the modernization of legacy systems.

sob_demanda.title: On-demand software
sob_demanda.text: Software built around each customer's needs, in the format their operation requires. The process has four steps: assessment, strategy, development and follow-up.

industria.title: Industrial and production management
industria.text: An integrated system that adapts to the particulars of each plant and delivers accurate information for decisions. It includes traceability across the whole life cycle of materials.
points: One integrated solution instead of many systems

nfe.title: Invoice management
nfe.text: A system that captures invoices automatically straight from SEFAZ, with no manual typing.

legados.title: Modernization, cloud and microservices
legados.text: Replaces old platforms with modern, cross-platform, cloud-based solutions. A microservices architecture splits the application into small, independent components.

tsmtools.name: TSM Tools
tsmtools.intro: Born from more than 25 years in the machining tools market. It serves the automotive, aerospace, oil & gas and other sectors.
tsmtools.highlight: ISO 9001 certified, with inspection of every tool and continuous process improvement.
tsmtools.roleText: Designs, makes and reconditions machining tools such as drills, milling cutters, reamers and countersinks.

desenvolvimento.title: Special tool development
desenvolvimento.text: Custom solutions for unique challenges. We create special tools with precision, technology and innovation for the most demanding markets.

fabricacao.title: Tool manufacturing
fabricacao.text: From concept to reality, we make special and standard tools that raise productivity, with guaranteed quality.
points: Drills, milling cutters, reamers and countersinks

recondicionamento.title: Reconditioning (sharpening)
recondicionamento.text: We turn worn tools into high-performance tools, with precision and savings.

engenharia.title: Application engineering
engenharia.text: Improvement of machining processes. Application engineering optimizes the process and turns challenges into efficiency.

toolservices.name: Tool Services
toolservices.intro: Analyzes, guides and optimizes processes to lower the cost of the final product. It controls tool life and reduces set-up time.
toolservices.highlight: According to the company: 30% lower consumption, 60% faster tool location and picking, and 90% less damage.
toolservices.roleText: Controls the tool cycle inside the customer's plant, from purchase to disposal, to extend tool life and cut costs.

logistica.title: Logistics
logistica.text: Coordinates tool purchase orders, stock control, suppliers and delivery, which shortens lead time.

presetting.title: Presetting
presetting.text: Floating stock control, including pickup and delivery, analysis, replenishment, assembly, measurement and storage of tools.

recondicionamento.title: Reconditioning
recondicionamento.text: Wear studies, tool resharpening, tests of new geometries, logistics and technical guidance for suppliers.

suporte.title: Support and training
suporte.text: Support for developing new products and technologies, improving productivity and training machine operators.

what.title: What we do
what.lead: Three fronts that fit together: the tool, the management of the tool and the software that controls the process.

social.title: Social media
social.lead: Point your phone camera at the code and follow the group.

overview.title: Overview
overview.thanksText: It was a pleasure to host you. If you want to talk about tools, management or software, get in touch.
